```{r}
dir.create("plots_pdf", showWarnings = FALSE)

theme_pub <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey85"),
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
      plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "grey30"),
      axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size - 1),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = base_size - 2),
      strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
      strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}


save_pub_pdf <- function(plot, filename, width = 10, height = 8) {
  path <- file.path("plots_pdf", filename)
  ggsave(path, plot, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf, limitsize = FALSE)
  cat("Saved:", path, "\n")
}
```

## Retrieving the data

Downloaded from Figshare as two archives: heart_facs and heart_droplet.

```{r, include=FALSE}
heart_facs    <- ad$read_h5ad("C:/Users/olaia/Desktop/WGCNA_mouse/data/Heart_facs.h5ad")
heart_droplet <-ad$read_h5ad("C:/Users/olaia/Desktop/WGCNA_mouse/data/Heart_droplet.h5ad")
```

## Combining datasets, normalization and data preparation

```{r}
# var_names is already the gene symbol
facs_genes    <- rownames(py_to_r(heart_facs$var))
droplet_genes <- rownames(py_to_r(heart_droplet$var))
shared_genes  <- intersect(facs_genes, droplet_genes)
cat("Shared genes:", length(shared_genes), "\n")

combined_heart <- ad$concat(
  list(heart_droplet, heart_facs),
  axis = 0L,
  join = "outer",
  keys = c("droplet", "facs"),
  label = "tech",
  index_unique = "-"
)
combined_genes <- py_to_r(combined_heart$var_names$values)
combined_cells <- py_to_r(combined_heart$obs_names$values)


rm(heart_facs, heart_droplet)
gc()

cat("Combined genes:", length(combined_genes), "\n")
cat("Combined cells:", length(combined_cells), "\n")

stopifnot(length(combined_genes) == ncol(combined_heart$X))
stopifnot(length(combined_cells) == nrow(combined_heart$X))

counts_matrix <- Matrix::t(as(combined_heart$X, "CsparseMatrix"))

sanitized_genes <- gsub("_", "-", combined_genes)
dup_idx <- duplicated(sanitized_genes) | duplicated(sanitized_genes, fromLast = TRUE)
if (sum(dup_idx) > 0) {
  cat("Genes affected by sanitization collisions:", sum(dup_idx), "\n")
  print(data.frame(original = combined_genes[dup_idx],
                   sanitized = sanitized_genes[dup_idx]))
}
final_genes <- make.unique(sanitized_genes)
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(final_genes)) == 0)
stopifnot(length(final_genes) == nrow(counts_matrix))

final_cells <- as.vector(combined_cells)
stopifnot(is.null(attributes(final_cells)))

rownames(counts_matrix) <- final_genes
colnames(counts_matrix) <- final_cells

metadata <- py_to_r(combined_heart$obs)
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(metadata) <- final_cells

# 'tech' should have exactly 2 levels (facs/droplet)
cat("'tech' values (real technology):\n")
print(table(metadata$tech))


if ("batch" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
  metadata$seq_batch <- metadata$batch
  metadata$batch <- NULL
}


if ("mouse.id" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
  metadata$sample_id <- as.character(metadata$mouse.id)
} else {
  metadata$sample_id <- paste(metadata$sex, metadata$age, sep = "_")
}

cat("Numero de sample_id unicos:", dplyr::n_distinct(metadata$sample_id), "\n")
table(metadata$sample_id)

cat("Do counts_matrix and metadata match?",
    identical(rownames(metadata), colnames(counts_matrix)), "\n")
stopifnot(identical(rownames(metadata), colnames(counts_matrix)))

seurat_combined <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts_matrix,
  meta.data = metadata,
  project = "WGCNA_Mouse_Combined"
)


rm(counts_matrix, combined_heart, combined_genes, combined_cells,
   sanitized_genes, final_genes, final_cells, metadata)
gc()
```

```{r}
# QC thresholds 
min_features <- 200
n_before <- ncol(seurat_combined)

seurat_combined <- subset(
  seurat_combined,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > min_features 
)
cat("Cells before QC:", n_before, "\n")
cat("Cells after QC:", ncol(seurat_combined), "\n")

# Remove genes detected in very few cells globally
min_cells_gene <- 3
detected_genes <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(seurat_combined, layer = "counts") > 0)
genes_to_keep <- names(detected_genes[detected_genes >= min_cells_gene])

cat("Genes before filter:", nrow(seurat_combined), "\n")
cat("Genes after filter:", length(genes_to_keep), "\n")

seurat_combined <- subset(seurat_combined, features = genes_to_keep)
seurat_combined <- NormalizeData(seurat_combined)
seurat_combined <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_combined)
seurat_combined <- ScaleData(seurat_combined)
seurat_combined <- RunPCA(seurat_combined)

seurat_combined <- RunHarmony(
  seurat_combined,
  group.by.vars = "tech",
  reduction.use = "pca",
  reduction.save = "harmony"
)

seurat_combined <- FindNeighbors(seurat_combined, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20)
seurat_combined <- RunUMAP(seurat_combined, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:15)
seurat_combined_filt <- subset(seurat_combined, subset = cell_ontology_class != "nan")


rm(seurat_combined, detected_genes, genes_to_keep)
gc()
```

```{r celltype-mapping}
# Collapse into 8 final categories. Cell types not listed here (e.g. mast
# cell, valve cell) are intentionally dropped from the analysis.

celltype_map <- c(
  "endothelial cell of coronary artery" = "EndothelialCells",
  "aortic endothelial cell"             = "EndothelialCells",
  "atrial myocyte"                      = "Myocytes",
  "ventricular myocyte"                 = "Myocytes",
  "cardiac neuron"                      = "CardiacNeurons",
  qaaaaaaa,
  "erythrocyte"                         = "Erythrocytes",
  "fibroblast of cardiac tissue"        = "Fibroblasts",
  "leukocyte"                           = "Leukocytes",
  "smooth muscle cell"                  = "SmoothMuscleCells"
  
)


meta <- seurat_combined_filt@meta.data
meta$cell_ontology_class_clean <- trimws(tolower(as.character(meta$cell_ontology_class)))


names(celltype_map) <- tolower(names(celltype_map))
meta$final_celltype <- celltype_map[meta$cell_ontology_class_clean]

unmapped <- sort(unique(meta$cell_ontology_class[is.na(meta$final_celltype)]))
```

## Build the pseudobulk matrix: mean expression (linear space) per gene x cell type x mouse

```{r build-pseudobulk-matrix}
DefaultAssay(seurat_combined_filt) <- "RNA"

all_genes<-rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_combined_filt, layer = "data"))

expr <- GetAssayData(seurat_combined_filt, layer = "data")[all_genes, ]

keep_cells <- rownames(meta)[!is.na(meta$final_celltype)]
meta_keep  <- meta[keep_cells, ]
expr_keep  <- expr[, keep_cells]

cat("Cells kept for pseudobulk:", ncol(expr_keep),
    "out of", ncol(expr), "\n")

final_celltypes <- sort(unique(meta_keep$final_celltype))
all_samples     <- sort(unique(meta_keep$sample_id))

cat("\nFinal cell types included:\n")
print(final_celltypes)
cat("\nNumber of mice (sample_id):", length(all_samples), "\n")

n_genes <- nrow(expr_keep)
block_list <- vector("list", length(final_celltypes))
names(block_list) <- final_celltypes

for (ct in final_celltypes) {
  ct_mat <- matrix(
    NA_real_, nrow = n_genes, ncol = length(all_samples),
    dimnames = list(rownames(expr_keep), all_samples)
  )
  for (s in all_samples) {
    cells_gs <- rownames(meta_keep)[meta_keep$sample_id == s & meta_keep$final_celltype == ct]
    if (length(cells_gs) > 0) {
      
      block_vals <- as.matrix(expr_keep[, cells_gs, drop = FALSE])
      ct_mat[, s] <- log1p(matrixStats::rowMeans2(expm1(block_vals)))
    }
    # length(cells_gs) == 0 -> stays NA_real_ (no data for this mouse/celltype)
  }
  rownames(ct_mat) <- paste(rownames(ct_mat), ct, sep = "_")
  block_list[[ct]] <- ct_mat
}

pseudobulk_matrix <- do.call(rbind, block_list)
cat("Pseudobulk matrix dimensions (gene_celltype x mouse):",
    nrow(pseudobulk_matrix), "x", ncol(pseudobulk_matrix), "\n")


n_dup <- sum(duplicated(rownames(pseudobulk_matrix)))
cat("Duplicated gene_celltype row names (should be 0):", n_dup, "\n")
stopifnot(n_dup == 0)

cat("\nCells contributing to each (mouse x celltype) combination:\n")
cell_count_tab <- table(meta_keep$sample_id, meta_keep$final_celltype)
print(cell_count_tab)
cat("\nNumber of (mouse x celltype) combinations with 0 cells (-> NA in the matrix):",
    sum(cell_count_tab == 0), "out of", length(cell_count_tab), "\n")

cat("\nOverall fraction of NA in pseudobulk_matrix:",
    round(mean(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix)), 4), "\n")
cat("Overall fraction of TRUE zero-expression values (non-NA, ==0):",
    round(mean(pseudobulk_matrix == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")


rm(expr, expr_keep, block_list, ct_mat)
gc()
```

## Diagnostic: which mice are missing which cell types?

```{r diagnose-missing-celltype-per-mouse}

# cell_count_tab: rows = mice, columns = final_celltype, values = n cells
missing_tab <- cell_count_tab == 0  # TRUE where a mouse has 0 cells of that type

# --- Per cell type: how many / which mice are missing it ---
celltype_missing_summary <- data.frame(
  celltype       = colnames(missing_tab),
  n_mice_missing = colSums(missing_tab),
  pct_mice_missing = round(100 * colSums(missing_tab) / nrow(missing_tab), 1),
  missing_mice   = sapply(colnames(missing_tab), function(ct) {
    paste(rownames(missing_tab)[missing_tab[, ct]], collapse = ", ")
  })
)
celltype_missing_summary <- celltype_missing_summary[order(-celltype_missing_summary$n_mice_missing), ]
rownames(celltype_missing_summary) <- NULL

cat("Cell types ranked by how many mice are missing them (out of",
    nrow(missing_tab), "mice):\n\n")
print(celltype_missing_summary, right = FALSE)

# --- Per mouse: how many / which cell types it's missing ---
mouse_missing_summary <- data.frame(
  mouse            = rownames(missing_tab),
  n_celltypes_missing = rowSums(missing_tab),
  missing_celltypes   = apply(missing_tab, 1, function(r) {
    paste(colnames(missing_tab)[r], collapse = ", ")
  })
)
mouse_missing_summary <- mouse_missing_summary[order(-mouse_missing_summary$n_celltypes_missing), ]
rownames(mouse_missing_summary) <- NULL

cat("\n\nMice ranked by how many cell types they're missing (out of",
    ncol(missing_tab), "cell types):\n\n")
print(mouse_missing_summary, right = FALSE)

# Save both for inspection outside the console
write.csv(celltype_missing_summary, "diagnostic_missing_by_celltype.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(mouse_missing_summary, "diagnostic_missing_by_mouse.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Drop majority-missing cell types, impute the rest

```{r}

MAX_MISSING_FRAC <- 0.5  # cell types missing in >50% of mice are dropped entirely

celltype_missing_summary$missing_frac <- celltype_missing_summary$pct_mice_missing / 100
celltypes_to_drop <- celltype_missing_summary$celltype[celltype_missing_summary$missing_frac > MAX_MISSING_FRAC]
celltypes_to_keep <- celltype_missing_summary$celltype[celltype_missing_summary$missing_frac <= MAX_MISSING_FRAC]

cat("Cell types DROPPED entirely (>", MAX_MISSING_FRAC * 100, "% of mice missing this type):\n")
print(celltypes_to_drop)
cat("\nCell types KEPT (imputing the few missing mice):\n")
print(celltypes_to_keep)


row_celltype <- sub("^.*_", "", rownames(pseudobulk_matrix))
pseudobulk_matrix_clean <- pseudobulk_matrix[row_celltype %in% celltypes_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]

cat("\nDimensions after dropping majority-missing cell types:",
    dim(pseudobulk_matrix_clean), "(gene_celltype x sample_id)\n")
cat("NA fraction before imputation:",
    round(mean(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)), 4), "\n")

# Mean-impute remaining NAs (per feature/row, restricted to mice of the SAME age group).
sample_ages <- meta$age[match(colnames(pseudobulk_matrix_clean), meta$sample_id)]
n_na_before <- sum(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix_clean))
global_row_means <- rowMeans(pseudobulk_matrix_clean, na.rm = TRUE)

for (a in unique(sample_ages)) {
  cols_a <- which(sample_ages == a)
  
  # Calculate row means for this specific age group
  age_row_means <- rowMeans(pseudobulk_matrix_clean[, cols_a, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Fallback to global row mean if all mice in this age group are NA for a feature
  nan_mask <- is.nan(age_row_means)
  if (any(nan_mask)) {
    age_row_means[nan_mask] <- global_row_means[nan_mask]
  }
  
  # Impute NAs within this age group's subset
  sub_mat <- pseudobulk_matrix_clean[, cols_a, drop = FALSE]
  na_sub_idx <- which(is.na(sub_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(na_sub_idx) > 0) {
    sub_mat[na_sub_idx] <- age_row_means[na_sub_idx[, 1]]
    pseudobulk_matrix_clean[, cols_a] <- sub_mat
  }
}

cat("\nValues imputed:", n_na_before, "\n")
cat("NAs remaining after imputation (should be 0):",
    sum(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)), "\n")
stopifnot(sum(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)) == 0)

```

```{r filter-complete-case}

cat("Pseudobulk matrix (post drop+impute) before this sanity check:\n")
cat("  Dimensions:", dim(pseudobulk_matrix_clean), "(gene_celltype × sample_id)\n")
cat("  NA count:", sum(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)), "\n")
cat("  NA fraction:", round(mean(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)), 4), "\n")


features_complete <- rownames(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)[rowSums(is.na(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)) == 0]
cat("\nFeatures with COMPLETE data (no NAs):", length(features_complete), "\n")
cat("Features eliminated (with ANY NA):", nrow(pseudobulk_matrix_clean) - length(features_complete), "\n")

# Keep only complete features (subset ROWS, not columns)
pseudobulk_complete <- pseudobulk_matrix_clean[features_complete, , drop = FALSE]

cat("\nPseudobulk matrix after complete-case filtering:\n")
cat("  Dimensions:", dim(pseudobulk_complete), "(gene_celltype x sample_id)\n")
cat("  NA fraction:", round(mean(is.na(pseudobulk_complete)), 4), "(should be 0)\n")

# Diagnostic: which cell types were hit hardest?
features_celltype <- sub("^.*_", "", rownames(pseudobulk_matrix_clean))
features_complete_celltype <- sub("^.*_", "", features_complete)

cat("\nFeature retention by cell type:\n")
retention_by_type <- data.frame()
for (ct in sort(unique(features_celltype))) {
  total <- sum(features_celltype == ct)
  retained <- sum(features_complete_celltype == ct)
  pct <- round(100 * retained / total, 1)
  retention_by_type <- rbind(retention_by_type, data.frame(
    celltype = ct, total = total, retained = retained, pct = pct
  ))
}
print(retention_by_type)

write.csv(retention_by_type, "feature_retention_by_celltype.csv", row.names = FALSE)


rm(pseudobulk_matrix_clean)
gc()
```

## Remove genes with zero expression across all samples

Instead of excluding genes belonging to a previously computed "grey"
module (from a separate global kME table), features are now filtered
directly from the pseudobulk matrix itself: any (gene x celltype)
feature whose expression is exactly 0 in **every** mouse is removed,
since it carries no signal and no variability to contribute to network
construction.

```{r remove-zero-expression-features}
n_before_zero_filter <- nrow(pseudobulk_complete)

all_zero_feature <- rowSums(pseudobulk_complete != 0) == 0
cat("Features with expression == 0 across ALL samples (to REMOVE):",
    sum(all_zero_feature), "\n")

pseudobulk_complete <- pseudobulk_complete[!all_zero_feature, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Features before zero-expression filter:", n_before_zero_filter, "\n")
cat("Features after zero-expression filter:", nrow(pseudobulk_complete), "\n")


features_complete <- rownames(pseudobulk_complete)
features_complete_celltype <- sub("^.*_", "", features_complete)

cat("\nFeatures remaining per cell type after zero-expression filter:\n")
print(table(features_complete_celltype))

rm(all_zero_feature, n_before_zero_filter)
```

### hdWGCNA pseudobulk setup: reuse the same imputed `datExpr` inside a minimal Seurat container

```{r setup-hdwgcna-object}

pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna <- pseudobulk_hvg  # gene_celltype (rows) x mice (columns)
stopifnot(!anyNA(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna))

original_gc_names          <- rownames(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna)
sanitized_gc_names         <- gsub("_", "-", original_gc_names)
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(sanitized_gc_names)) == 0)  # sanity: no collisions after sanitizing
hdwgcna_name_map            <- setNames(original_gc_names, sanitized_gc_names)  # sanitized -> original

rownames(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna) <- sanitized_gc_names

hdwgcna_dummy_meta <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna),
  sample_id = colnames(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna)
)


seurat_hd <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts    = pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna,
  meta.data = hdwgcna_dummy_meta,
  project   = "WGCNA_pseudobulk_hdWGCNA"
)


stopifnot(all(rownames(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna) %in% rownames(seurat_hd)))

seurat_hd <- SetupForWGCNA(
  seurat_hd,
  features   = rownames(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna),
  wgcna_name = "pseudobulk"
)

seurat_hd <- SetDatExpr(
  seurat_hd,
  mat        = t(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna),
  wgcna_name = "pseudobulk"
)


cat("hdWGCNA container ready:", nrow(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna), "features x",
    ncol(pseudobulk_mat_for_hdwgcna), "mice\n")

dir.create("TOM_pseudobulk", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r blockwise-final-after-scan}
soft_power<-10

  seurat_hd,
  soft_power      = soft_power,
  corType         = "bicor",

  networkType     = "signed",

)
```

## Module-age correlation

Unlike the metacell-based approach, `datExpr` is **already one row per
mouse** (the pseudobulk aggregation collapsed all cells of a given mouse
x cell type into a single value). This means there is no
pseudoreplication to correct for here: `n` in every correlation below is
genuinely the number of mice, not the number of cells, so no separate
cell-level/mouse-level aggregation step is needed as it was in the
metacell workflow.

```{r age-per-mouse}

age_per_mouse <- meta_keep %>%
  distinct(sample_id, age) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(n_ages = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

stopifnot("Some mice have more than one 'age' value -- inspect age_per_mouse" =
            all(age_per_mouse$n_ages == 1))

age_lookup <- setNames(as.character(age_per_mouse$age), age_per_mouse$sample_id)

ordered_age_levels <- unique(age_lookup)
ordered_age_levels <- ordered_age_levels[
  order(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", ordered_age_levels)))
]
cat("Chronological order of 'age' used throughout the analysis:\n")
print(ordered_age_levels)

mouse_age <- factor(age_lookup[rownames(t(pseudobulk_hvg))], levels = ordered_age_levels, ordered = TRUE)
stopifnot(!any(is.na(mouse_age)))

age_num <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", as.character(mouse_age)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(age_num)))

cat("\nMice per age group in datExpr:\n")
print(table(mouse_age))
cat("\nNumeric age values used as 'age_num' (real units, not rank):\n")
print(sort(unique(age_num)))
```

```{r module-trait-correlation}
n_mice <- nrow(MEs)

module_trait_cor <- sapply(MEs, function(me) cor(me, age_num, method = "pearson"))
module_trait_p <- sapply(module_trait_cor, function(r) {
  if (is.na(r) || n_mice <= 3) return(1)
  t_val <- r * sqrt((n_mice - 2) / (1 - r^2))
  2 * pt(-abs(t_val), df = n_mice - 2)
})

module_trait_table <- data.frame(
  module      = sub("^ME", "", names(module_trait_cor)),
  correlation = as.numeric(module_trait_cor),
  p_value     = as.numeric(module_trait_p),
  n_mice      = n_mice
) %>%
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(fdr)

cat("Module-age correlation (n =", n_mice, "mice):\n")
print(module_trait_table)

write.csv(module_trait_table, "module_age_correlation.csv", row.names = FALSE)

significant_modules <- module_trait_table %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>% pull(module)
cat("\nModules significantly associated with age (FDR < 0.05):\n")
print(significant_modules)
```

```{r module-trait-heatmap, fig.width=6, fig.height=8}
trait_mat <- matrix(module_trait_cor, ncol = 1,
                     dimnames = list(sub("^ME", "", names(module_trait_cor)), "age"))
p_mat <- matrix(module_trait_p, ncol = 1)
text_mat <- paste0(signif(trait_mat, 2), "\n(", signif(p_mat, 1), ")")
dim(text_mat) <- dim(trait_mat)

labeledHeatmap(
  Matrix = trait_mat,
  xLabels = "age",
  yLabels = rownames(trait_mat),
  ySymbols = rownames(trait_mat),
  colorLabels = FALSE,
  colors = blueWhiteRed(50),
  textMatrix = text_mat,
  setStdMargins = FALSE,
  cex.text = 0.6,
  zlim = c(-1, 1),
  main = "Module-age correlations (pseudobulk, n = mice)"
)
```

### Dot plot: module-age association :

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)   
library(ggtext)   
library(RColorBrewer)


dotplot_data_pub <- data.frame(
  module = sub("^ME", "", names(module_trait_cor)),
  correlation = as.vector(module_trait_cor),
  pvalue = as.vector(module_trait_p),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    fdr = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
    neg_log_fdr = -log10(pmax(fdr, 1e-300)),
    is_significant = ifelse(fdr < 0.05, "FDR < 0.05", "Not significant"),
    # Factorizar módulos ordenados por el valor de correlación
    module_ordered = factor(module, levels = module[order(correlation)])
  )


p_publication <- ggplot(dotplot_data_pub, aes(x = correlation, y = module_ordered)) +
  
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = correlation, y = module_ordered, yend = module_ordered),
    color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  # Línea neutra en el cero
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Puntos con mapa de color divergente (RdBu)
  geom_point(
    aes(size = neg_log_fdr, fill = correlation, color = is_significant),
    shape = 21, stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  # Escala de color continuo (Azul a Rojo)
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "RdBu", direction = -1, limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Correlation (*r*)"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FDR < 0.05" = "black", "Not significant" = "grey85"),
    name = "Significance"
  ) +
  # Escala de tamaños
  scale_size_continuous(name = "-log<sub>10</sub>(FDR)", range = c(2.5, 7.5)) +
  # Textos y etiquetas con Markdown
  labs(
    x = "Module Eigengene Correlation (*r*)",
    y = "WGCNA Module",
    title = "Overall Module-Age Trait Association",
    subtitle = "Point fill indicates **correlation**, size indicates **-log<sub>10</sub>(FDR)**"
  ) +
  # Tema pubr ajustado
  theme_pubr(base_size = 11, border = TRUE) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(size = 9, color = "grey35"),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_markdown(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0", linetype = "dotted")
  )

print(p_publication)

# Exportar en formato vectorial (PDF HD)
ggsave(
  filename = "figure_module_age_association.pdf",
  plot = p_publication,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 6.5,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### Panel: regression bars + p-value dots (module colors)

```{r}
# Total genes per module (grey excluded), reused for point size on the
# FDR panel -- same "number of genes" encoding as the reference figure.
module_gene_counts <- gene_celltype_module %>%
  dplyr::filter(module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(module, gene) %>%
  dplyr::count(module, name = "n_genes")

fig_regression_data <- module_trait_table %>%
  dplyr::left_join(module_gene_counts, by = "module") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_color = module,                       # module name IS a valid R color
    fdr_plot     = pmax(fdr, 1e-4),               # floor for the log10 axis -- ajusta 'fdr' al nombre real de tu columna
    sig_fdr      = fdr < 0.05,
    point_border = ifelse(sig_fdr, "grey15", "grey15"),   # borde rojo si es significativo
    point_stroke = ifelse(sig_fdr, 1.0, 0.4),
    module = factor(module, levels = module[order(correlation)])
  )

# --- Left panel: horizontal bars, one per module, filled with its own color -
p_reg_bars <- ggplot(fig_regression_data, aes(x = correlation, y = module)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = module_color), color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.72) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Regression (Pearson r vs. age)", y = NULL, title = "Regression") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# --- Right panel: -log10 FDR as dot position (log10 x-axis), dot size ------
# encodes module size (number of genes), dot filled with the module's color,
# and outlined in red when FDR < 0.05 to flag significant modules at a glance.
p_reg_fdr <- ggplot(fig_regression_data, aes(x = fdr_plot, y = module)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_genes, fill = module_color, color = point_border, stroke = point_stroke),
             shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number\nof genes", range = c(2, 9)) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(1e-4, 1), breaks = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "FDR", y = NULL, title = "FDR") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_regression_panel <- p_reg_bars + p_reg_fdr +
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 1)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Module-age regression across all WGCNA modules",
    subtitle = "Highlighted border= FDR < 0.05",
    theme = theme_pub(base_size = 13)
  )

print(p_regression_panel)

save_pub_pdf(p_regression_panel, "figure_module_age_regression.pdf",
             width = 9, height = max(4, 0.42 * nrow(fig_regression_data) + 1.5))
```

## Hub genes (top kME per module)

`signedKME` gives each gene_celltype feature its correlation (module
membership, kME) to every module eigengene. As in the metacell workflow,
a fixed kME cutoff isn't comparable across modules of different
size/cohesion, so hub genes are defined as the **top kME percentile
within each module**.

```{r hub-genes}
kME_table <- signedKME(
  datExpr, MEs, corFnc = "bicor",
  # datExpr has no NAs after imputation -- all.obs uses bicor's fast path
  corOptions = "use = 'all.obs', maxPOutliers = 0.1, pearsonFallback = 'individual'"
)
colnames(kME_table) <- sub("^kME", "", colnames(kME_table))

gene_celltype_module$kME <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(gene_celltype_module)), function(i) {
  mod <- gene_celltype_module$module[i]
  feat <- gene_celltype_module$gene_celltype[i]
  if (mod == "grey" || !mod %in% colnames(kME_table)) return(NA_real_)
  kME_table[feat, mod]
})

hub_percentile <- 0.90  # top 10% by kME within each module

hub_genes_table <- gene_celltype_module %>%
  filter(module != "grey") %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  filter(kME >= quantile(kME, hub_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(module, desc(kME))

write.csv(hub_genes_table, "hub_genes_by_module.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Hub genes per module (top", (1 - hub_percentile) * 100, "% kME):\n")
print(table(hub_genes_table$module))

cat("\nHub gene composition by module x cell type of origin:\n")
print(table(hub_genes_table$module, hub_genes_table$celltype))
```

## Module co-expression network interactions

The TOM computed during `ConstructNetwork()` in the parameter scan above
was cached to disk by hdWGCNA (`tom_outdir/tom_name*.rds`). This chunk
loads that cached TOM (or rebuilds it safely via block-wise computation
if something goes wrong), then every network plot below reuses it.

```{r final-tom-cache}
# ============ CONFIGURACIÓN ============
# Cambia esta ruta si TOM_pseudobulk no está en el working directory actual.
# Puede ser relativa (ej. "TOM_pseudobulk", "resultados/TOM_pseudobulk")
# o absoluta (ej. "/home/usuario/proyecto/TOM_pseudobulk",
#              "C:/Users/usuario/proyecto/TOM_pseudobulk").
tom_outdir_used <- "D:/SandraAnjo/Luis Grilo/WGCNAandothersOlaia/WGCNA_12_08/TOM_pseudobulk"

tom_name_used   <- "pseudobulk_scan"   # prefijo usado en ConstructNetwork(tom_name = ...)
wgcna_name_used <- "pseudobulk"        # el wgcna_name usado en ConstructNetwork()

tom_final_path      <- "final_TOM_combined.rds"
force_recompute_tom <- FALSE
# ========================================

if (!dir.exists(tom_outdir_used)) {
  stop("La carpeta '", tom_outdir_used, "' no existe desde el working directory actual (",
       getwd(), "). Ajusta 'tom_outdir_used' arriba con la ruta correcta.")
}

if (file.exists(tom_final_path) && !force_recompute_tom) {
  
  final_TOM <- readRDS(tom_final_path)
  cat("Loaded cached combined TOM from", tom_final_path, "(",
      nrow(final_TOM), "x", ncol(final_TOM), ")\n")
  
} else {
  
  cat("No cached", tom_final_path, "yet -- building it from the network",
      "already computed in seurat_hd /", tom_outdir_used, "(no recomputation needed).\n")
  cat("Working directory:", getwd(), "\n")
  cat("Contents of", tom_outdir_used, ":\n")
  print(list.files(tom_outdir_used, full.names = FALSE))
  
  # ---- Primary path: GetTOM() reads the combined TOM file that hdWGCNA
  # already wrote to disk during ConstructNetwork() (the "*_TOM*" file,
  # NOT the per-block "*_block.N*" files). This is the expected, cheap path
  # whenever seurat_hd already has the network built (e.g. loaded from .RData).
  cat("Attempting to load TOM via GetTOM(seurat_hd, wgcna_name = '", wgcna_name_used, "')...\n", sep = "")
  
  final_TOM <- tryCatch(
    {
      tom_from_hdwgcna <- GetTOM(seurat_hd, wgcna_name = wgcna_name_used)
      
      # GetTOM() returns row/colnames using hdWGCNA's SANITIZED feature
      # names ("-" instead of "_"); translate back via hdwgcna_name_map so
      # downstream lookups by original gene_celltype name (which use "_")
      # keep working.
      tom_names_original <- hdwgcna_name_map[rownames(tom_from_hdwgcna)]
      stopifnot("Some GetTOM() feature names are missing from hdwgcna_name_map -- name mismatch upstream" =
                  !anyNA(tom_names_original))
      rownames(tom_from_hdwgcna) <- tom_names_original
      colnames(tom_from_hdwgcna) <- tom_names_original
      
      cat("Successfully loaded TOM from hdWGCNA cache (",
          nrow(tom_from_hdwgcna), "x", ncol(tom_from_hdwgcna), ")\n")
      tom_from_hdwgcna
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("GetTOM() failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      cat("Falling back to manually combining the per-block TOM files",
          "already on disk in", tom_outdir_used, "...\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  # ---- Fallback: GetTOM() failed (e.g. path mismatch after mover el proyecto)
  # pero los archivos TOM por bloque de ConstructNetwork() siguen en
  # tom_outdir_used. Los combina directamente usando el mapeo gen->bloque
  # ya guardado en `net` (de GetNetworkData(), calculado más arriba en el
  # script) -- sin necesidad de rerun blockwiseModules().
  if (is.null(final_TOM)) {
    
    stopifnot("`net` (from GetNetworkData(seurat_hd, ...)) is not in the environment -- rerun the 'blockwise-final-after-scan' chunk first" =
                exists("net") && !is.null(net$blockGenes))
    
    block_files <- list.files(
      tom_outdir_used,
      pattern    = paste0("^", tom_name_used, ".*block.*\\.(rds|RData|rda)$"),
      full.names = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
    cat("Found", length(block_files), "candidate block TOM file(s):\n")
    print(block_files)

    if (length(block_files) == 0) {
      stop("No per-block TOM files matching '", tom_name_used, "*block*' found in ", tom_outdir_used,
           " -- check tom_name_used/tom_outdir_used above match what ConstructNetwork() actually used.")
    }

    load_tom_block <- function(path) {
      if (grepl("\\.rds$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        readRDS(path)
      } else {
        # .RData/.rda block files from blockwiseModules(saveTOMs = TRUE)
        # store the TOM as a single object -- typically named 'TOM'.
        e <- new.env()
        loaded <- load(path, envir = e)
        e[[loaded[1]]]
      }
    }

    all_features <- unlist(net$blockGenes)
    final_TOM <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(all_features), ncol = length(all_features))
    rownames(final_TOM) <- colnames(datExpr)[all_features]
    colnames(final_TOM) <- colnames(datExpr)[all_features]

    n_combined <- 0
    for (block_idx in seq_along(net$blockGenes)) {
      block_file <- block_files[grepl(paste0("block\\.?", block_idx, "(\\.|$)"), block_files)]
      if (length(block_file) == 0) {
        warning("No TOM file found for block ", block_idx, " -- leaving those entries as NA")
        next
      }
      tom_block <- load_tom_block(block_file[1])
      block_features <- net$blockGenes[[block_idx]]
      final_TOM[block_features, block_features] <- as.matrix(tom_block)
      n_combined <- n_combined + 1
    }

    stopifnot("Could not reconstruct final_TOM from any block file" = n_combined > 0)
    cat("Combined", n_combined, "of", length(net$blockGenes), "block TOMs into one",
        nrow(final_TOM), "x", ncol(final_TOM), "matrix\n")

    tom_names_original <- hdwgcna_name_map[rownames(final_TOM)]
    stopifnot("Some block-TOM feature names are missing from hdwgcna_name_map -- name mismatch upstream" =
                !anyNA(tom_names_original))
    rownames(final_TOM) <- tom_names_original
    colnames(final_TOM) <- tom_names_original
  }

  stopifnot(!anyNA(diag(final_TOM)))  # diagonal should be 1, never NA

  # Cache the final TOM for future runs
  saveRDS(final_TOM, tom_final_path)
  cat("Cached combined TOM to", tom_final_path, "\n")
}

stopifnot(nrow(final_TOM) == ncol(final_TOM))
stopifnot(all(rownames(final_TOM) == colnames(final_TOM)))
cat("Final TOM ready:", nrow(final_TOM), "x", ncol(final_TOM), "features\n")
```

### Per-module network (top hub genes, intra-module TOM edges)

One circular network per module, edges = TOM similarity among that
module's top-kME features, node labels = gene name (cell-type suffix
dropped for readability, but each node is still a single `gene_celltype`
feature).

```{r per-module-network, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)


dir.create("module_networks", showWarnings = FALSE)

n_show <- 25           # Número de top genes por módulo a evaluar
top_edge_prop <- 0.25  # Mostrar solo el Top 25% de aristas TOM más fuertes


plot_module_network <- function(mod, n_show = 25, top_edge_prop = 0.25) {
  # Limpiar el prefijo "ME" si está presente
  mod_clean <- sub("^ME", "", mod)

  # Extraer y ordenar features por kME
  feats <- kME_table[, mod_clean]
  names(feats) <- rownames(kME_table)
  feats <- feats[!is.na(feats)]

  top_feats <- names(sort(feats, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(n_show, length(feats)))]
  top_feats <- intersect(top_feats, rownames(final_TOM))

  if (length(top_feats) < 3) return(NULL)

  kme_vals <- feats[top_feats]

  # Sub-matriz TOM y extracción de aristas
  sub_tom <- final_TOM[top_feats, top_feats]
  sub_tom[upper.tri(sub_tom, diag = TRUE)] <- NA

  edges <- reshape2::melt(sub_tom) %>%
    dplyr::rename(from = Var1, to = Var2, weight = value) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(weight))

  # Filtrar solo el top % de conexiones TOM más fuertes (evita la bola de pelo)
  tom_cutoff <- quantile(edges$weight, probs = 1 - top_edge_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
  edges_filtered <- edges %>% dplyr::filter(weight >= tom_cutoff)

  # Creación del grafo inicial
  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edges_filtered, vertices = data.frame(name = top_feats), directed = FALSE)

  # --- ELIMINAR NODOS AISLADOS (Grado = 0) ---
  g <- igraph::delete_vertices(g, V(g)[igraph::degree(g) == 0])

  # Verificar si quedan suficientes nodos para graficar
  if (igraph::vcount(g) < 3) return(NULL)

  # Asignar atributos a los nodos
  V(g)$gene   <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", V(g)$name)
  V(g)$kME    <- kme_vals[V(g)$name]
  V(g)$degree <- igraph::degree(g)

  mod_color <- mod_clean

  # Renderizado visual con ggraph (Layout 'stress' para centralizar hubs)
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = "stress") +
    # Aristas
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(alpha = weight, width = weight),
      color = "grey40",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_edge_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.15, 0.65)) +
    scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(0.3, 1.1)) +

    # Nodos (El tamaño escala según kME)
    geom_node_point(
      aes(size = kME),
      fill = mod_color,
      color = "black",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 7.5), name = "Module Membership\n(kME)") +

    # Etiquetas con halo blanco de protección tras el texto
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = gene),
      repel = TRUE,
      size = 3.2,
      fontface = "italic",
      bg.color = "white",
      bg.r = 0.15,
      max.overlaps = 30
    ) +

    # Títulos y metadatos
    labs(
      title = paste0("Module ", mod_clean, " Co-expression Network"),
      subtitle = paste0("Showing connected top genes | Top ", round(top_edge_prop * 100), "% TOM connections")
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8.5, color = "grey35", margin = margin(b = 10)),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
    )

  return(p)
}


for (mod in module_names) {
  cat("Procesando módulo:", mod, "...\n")

  p <- plot_module_network(mod, n_show = n_show, top_edge_prop = top_edge_prop)

  if (is.null(p)) {
    cat("  -> Omitido (insuficientes genes conectados)\n")
    next
  }

  # Imprimir en consola / visor de RStudio
  print(p)

  # Guardar archivo PDF individual
  file_name <- file.path("module_networks", paste0("network_", mod, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(file_name, p, width = 6.5, height = 6, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 300)
  cat("  -> Guardado en:", file_name, "\n")
}


```

### Comprehensive network: all modules, hub genes, inter-module edges in grey

Combines every module's hub genes into one graph. Intra-module edges are
colored by module (top 15% kept per module, minimum 5, so the plot stays
legible); inter-module edges -- where two hub genes from different
modules are still strongly TOM-connected -- are shown in grey,
highlighting cross-module structure.

```{r}

library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(uwot)      # Para el cálculo de UMAP
library(ggforce)   # Para los sombreados (hulls)


n_hubs_combined <- 15

hub_feats_table <- hub_genes_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module_clean = sub("^ME", "", module)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_clean) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(kME, n = n_hubs_combined, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

hub_feats_combined <- hub_feats_table %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene_celltype) %>%
  intersect(rownames(final_TOM)) %>%
  unique()


cur_tom_full <- final_TOM[hub_feats_combined, hub_feats_combined]
tom_dist <- as.dist(1 - cur_tom_full)

set.seed(42)
umap_res <- uwot::umap(
  tom_dist,
  n_neighbors = min(15, length(hub_feats_combined) - 1),
  min_dist = 0.3,
  metric = "euclidean"
)

layout_umap <- data.frame(
  name = hub_feats_combined,
  x = umap_res[, 1],
  y = umap_res[, 2]
)

cur_tom <- cur_tom_full
cur_tom[upper.tri(cur_tom, diag = TRUE)] <- NA

cur_network <- reshape2::melt(cur_tom) %>%
  dplyr::rename(feat1 = Var1, feat2 = Var2, weight = value) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(weight))

feat_module_lookup <- gene_celltype_module %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module_clean = sub("^ME", "", module)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_celltype %in% hub_feats_combined) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_celltype, module_clean) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

cur_network <- cur_network %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module1 = feat_module_lookup[as.character(feat1)],
    module2 = feat_module_lookup[as.character(feat2)],
    edge_color = ifelse(module1 == module2, module1, "grey85")
  )

# Filtrado de aristas
edge_percent <- 0.15
min_edges_per_module <- 5

cur_network_intra <- cur_network %>%
  dplyr::filter(edge_color != "grey85") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(edge_color) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ dplyr::slice_max(.x, order_by = weight,
                                         n = pmax(min_edges_per_module, round(nrow(.x) * edge_percent)))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cur_network_inter <- cur_network %>%
  dplyr::filter(edge_color == "grey85") %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(weight, prop = 0.02)

cur_network_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(cur_network_intra, cur_network_inter)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Construcción del Grafo (Llamadas explícitas a igraph)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  cur_network_final %>% dplyr::select(feat1, feat2, weight, edge_color),
  directed = FALSE
)

V(g)$module <- feat_module_lookup[V(g)$name]
V(g)$gene   <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", V(g)$name)

# Cambio clave aquí: llamamos directamente a igraph::degree
V(g)$degree <- igraph::degree(g)

layout_graph <- ggraph::create_layout(
  g, layout = "manual",
  x = layout_umap$x[match(V(g)$name, layout_umap$name)],
  y = layout_umap$y[match(V(g)$name, layout_umap$name)]
)

modules_present <- unique(V(g)$module)
module_palette <- setNames(modules_present, modules_present)


p_combined <- ggraph(layout_graph) +
  geom_mark_hull(
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = module, group = module),
    concavity = 2,
    expand = unit(4, "mm"),
    alpha = 0.12,
    color = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(filter = (edge_color == "grey85"), alpha = weight),
    color = "grey80", width = 0.25, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(filter = (edge_color != "grey85"), alpha = weight, color = edge_color),
    width = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = module, size = degree), alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = gene),
    repel = TRUE,
    max.overlaps = 25,
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    point.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = module_palette, name = "Module") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = module_palette) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c(module_palette, "grey85" = "grey85"), guide = "none") +
  scale_edge_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.15, 0.7), name = "TOM Co-expression") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.5, 6), name = "Degree") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Integrated Co-expression Hub Network (UMAP Layout)")

ggsave("comprehensive_module_network_umap.pdf", p_combined, width = 14, height = 12, limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 300)
print(p_combined)
```

## Entrez mapping and enrichment universe

Every downstream enrichment (GO / KEGG / Reactome, always split by cell
type -- see next section) is tested against the same background
universe: every gene that entered the WGCNA network
(`gene_celltype_module`, grey module excluded upstream), mapped to
Entrez IDs once here and reused everywhere below.
`convert_to_entrez_flexible()` is the shared helper that maps a named
list of gene vectors (one per group -- module, or module x cell type) to
Entrez IDs, dropping groups with too few mapped genes.

```{r entrez-universe-and-helpers}
cat("Genes in gene_celltype_module (grey excluded):",
    length(unique(gene_celltype_module$gene)), "\n")
cat("Genes in the matrix that entered blockwiseModules (datExpr):",
    ncol(datExpr), "\n")

universe_symbols <- gene_celltype_module %>%
  distinct(gene) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

universe_entrez_map <- bitr(
  universe_symbols, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
)

cat("Symbols in universe:", length(universe_symbols), "\n")
cat("Mapped to Entrez:", nrow(universe_entrez_map), "\n")
cat("Not mapped:", length(universe_symbols) - nrow(universe_entrez_map), "\n")

universe_entrez <- universe_entrez_map$ENTREZID %>% unique() %>% na.omit()
cat("Final Entrez universe:", length(universe_entrez), "\n\n")

convert_to_entrez_flexible <- function(gene_list, min_genes = 1, verbose = TRUE) {
  result <- list()
  dropped_modules <- data.frame(
    module = character(),
    n_genes_original = integer(),
    n_genes_mapped = integer(),
    reason = character()
  )

  for (mod in names(gene_list)) {
    genes <- gene_list[[mod]]

    converted <- tryCatch(
      bitr(genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(converted) || nrow(converted) == 0) {
      if (verbose) {
        dropped_modules <- rbind(dropped_modules, data.frame(
          module = mod, n_genes_original = length(genes),
          n_genes_mapped = 0, reason = "No genes mapped to ENTREZID"
        ))
      }
      next
    }

    entrez_ids <- unique(na.omit(converted$ENTREZID))

    if (length(entrez_ids) < min_genes) {
      if (verbose) {
        dropped_modules <- rbind(dropped_modules, data.frame(
          module = mod, n_genes_original = length(genes),
          n_genes_mapped = length(entrez_ids),
          reason = paste0("Only ", length(entrez_ids), " genes mapped (min: ", min_genes, ")")
        ))
      }
      next
    }

    result[[mod]] <- entrez_ids
  }

  if (verbose && nrow(dropped_modules) > 0) {
    cat("\nGroups excluded:\n")
    print(dropped_modules, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  return(result)
}
```

## Functional enrichment by cell type within each module (GO / KEGG / Reactome)

```{r enrichment-by-celltype-within-module}
gene_counts_by_module_celltype <- gene_celltype_module %>%
  filter(module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::count(module, celltype, name = "n_genes")


run_enrichment_by_celltype <- function(fun_name,
                                       database_label,
                                       extra_args = list(),
                                       cache_file,
                                       force_recompute = TRUE) {
  
  if (file.exists(cache_file) && !force_recompute) {
    df_cached <- read.csv(cache_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cat("[", database_label, "] Loaded cached results from ", cache_file,
        " (", nrow(df_cached), " rows). Set force_recompute_enrichment_celltype <- TRUE to redo.\n", sep = "")
    return(df_cached)
  }
  
  result_list <- list()
  modules_all <- unique(gene_celltype_module$module[gene_celltype_module$module != "grey"])
  
  for (mod in modules_all) {
    genes_mod <- gene_celltype_module %>% filter(module == mod)
    
    gene_list_ct <- split(genes_mod$gene, genes_mod$celltype)
    gene_list_ct <- lapply(gene_list_ct, unique)
    
    gene_list_ct_entrez <- convert_to_entrez_flexible(gene_list_ct, min_genes = 3, verbose = FALSE)
    if (length(gene_list_ct_entrez) == 0) next
    
    call_args <- c(
      list(
        geneCluster   = gene_list_ct_entrez,
        fun           = fun_name,
        universe      = universe_entrez,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
      ),
      extra_args
    )
    
    ego_mod <- tryCatch(
      do.call(compareCluster, call_args),
      error = function(e) {
        message("[", database_label, "] Module ", mod, ": failed (", conditionMessage(e), ")")
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(ego_mod)) next
    
    df_mod <- as.data.frame(ego_mod)
    if (nrow(df_mod) == 0) next
    
    df_mod$module   <- mod
    df_mod$database <- database_label
    colnames(df_mod)[colnames(df_mod) == "Cluster"] <- "celltype"
    result_list[[mod]] <- df_mod
  }
  
  df_out <- bind_rows(result_list)
  write.csv(df_out, cache_file, row.names = TRUE)
  cat("[", database_label, "] Computed fresh and saved to ", cache_file, "\n", sep = "")
  df_out
}

force_recompute_enrichment_celltype <- TRUE

go_bp_by_module_celltype <- run_enrichment_by_celltype(
  fun_name       = "enrichGO",
  database_label = "GO_BP",
  extra_args     = list(OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, ont = "BP", qvalueCutoff = 0.2, readable = TRUE),
  cache_file     = "GO_BP_by_module_and_celltype.csv",
  force_recompute = force_recompute_enrichment_celltype
)

kegg_by_module_celltype <- run_enrichment_by_celltype(
  fun_name       = "enrichKEGG",
  database_label = "KEGG",

  cache_file     = "KEGG_by_module_and_celltype.csv",

)

reactome_by_module_celltype <- run_enrichment_by_celltype(

filter_out_kegg_disease <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  is_disease <- grepl("^[a-z]{3,4}05\\d{3}$", df$ID)
  n_removed <- sum(is_disease)
  if (n_removed > 0) {
    cat("KEGG: removed", n_removed, "term(s) from the 'Human Diseases' category (map 05xxx), e.g.:\n")
    print(head(unique(df$Description[is_disease]), 5))
  }
  df[!is_disease, , drop = FALSE]
}


get_reactome_disease_ids <- function(species = "Mus musculus") {
  url <- paste0("https://reactome.org/ContentService/data/eventsHierarchy/",
                utils::URLencode(species))
  res <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res)) return(character(0))
  
  collect_ids <- function(node) {
    ids <- character(0)
    if (!is.null(node$stId)) ids <- c(ids, node$stId)
    if (!is.null(node$children)) ids <- c(ids, unlist(lapply(node$children, collect_ids)))
    ids
  }
  
  disease_nodes <- Filter(function(n) isTRUE(n$name == "Disease"), res)
  if (length(disease_nodes) == 0) return(character(0))
  unique(unlist(lapply(disease_nodes, collect_ids)))
}

reactome_disease_ids <- tryCatch(get_reactome_disease_ids("Mus musculus"), error = function(e) character(0))
if (length(reactome_disease_ids) == 0) {
  cat("Reactome: could not resolve the 'Disease' branch from the ContentService API",
      "(offline, or the service is unavailable) -- falling back to keyword-only filtering.\n")
} else {
  cat("Reactome: resolved", length(reactome_disease_ids), "pathway IDs under the 'Disease' top-level category.\n")
}

# Keyword fallback / extra safety net -- catches disease terms even when the
# ID-based hierarchy above is unavailable or misses a branch.
reactome_disease_keywords <- c(
  "cancer", "carcinoma", "tumou?r", "leukemia", "lymphoma", "melanoma",
  "sarcoma", "glioma", "neoplasm", "metastas", "diabetes", "alzheimer",
  "parkinson", "huntington", "prion disease", "amyotrophic lateral sclerosis",
  "hepatitis", "influenza", "malaria", "tuberculosis", "leishmania",
  "trypanosom", "sars-cov|coronavirus|covid", "hiv infection|aids",
  "addiction", "substance abuse", "infection (by|with|of)", "viral inf",
  "bacterial inf", "human papillomavirus|\\bhpv\\b", "measles", "salmonella",
  "listeria|shigella", "legionella", "yersinia", "chlamydia",
  "helicobacter pylori", "asthma", "rheumatoid arthritis", "systemic lupus",
  "psoriasis", "graft-versus-host", "diseases associated with"
)
reactome_disease_kw_regex <- paste(reactome_disease_keywords, collapse = "|")

filter_out_reactome_disease <- function(df, disease_ids) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  by_id      <- df$ID %in% disease_ids
  by_keyword <- grepl(reactome_disease_kw_regex, df$Description, ignore.case = TRUE)
  is_disease <- by_id | by_keyword
  n_removed <- sum(is_disease)
  if (n_removed > 0) {
    cat("Reactome: removed", n_removed, "disease-related term(s), e.g.:\n")
    print(head(unique(df$Description[is_disease]), 5))
  }
  df[!is_disease, , drop = FALSE]
}

kegg_by_module_celltype     <- filter_out_kegg_disease(kegg_by_module_celltype)
reactome_by_module_celltype <- filter_out_reactome_disease(reactome_by_module_celltype, reactome_disease_ids)

# KEGG/Reactome results are readable=FALSE by default (Entrez IDs in geneID);
# convert them to gene symbols so downstream code is uniform across databases.
make_geneid_readable <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df$geneID <- vapply(df$geneID, function(ids) {
    entrez <- strsplit(ids, "/")[[1]]
    sym <- suppressMessages(
      tryCatch(bitr(entrez, fromType = "ENTREZID", toType = "SYMBOL", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db),
               error = function(e) NULL)
    )
    if (is.null(sym) || nrow(sym) == 0) return(ids)
    paste(sym$SYMBOL[match(entrez, sym$ENTREZID)], collapse = "/")
  }, character(1))
  df
}

kegg_by_module_celltype     <- make_geneid_readable(kegg_by_module_celltype)
reactome_by_module_celltype <- make_geneid_readable(reactome_by_module_celltype)

# Stacked long table used by every plotting function below
enrichment_by_module_celltype <- bind_rows(
  go_bp_by_module_celltype,
  kegg_by_module_celltype,
  reactome_by_module_celltype
)

# Kept as an alias so earlier chunks referring to go_by_module_celltype still work

cat("\nTerms found, by database x module x cell type:\n")
print(enrichment_by_module_celltype %>%
        dplyr::count(database, module, celltype, name = "n_sig_terms") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = celltype, values_from = n_sig_terms, values_fill = 0))
```

### Activity-score proxy for coloring (kME-weighted, per term x cell type)

`enrichGO`/`enrichKEGG`/`enrichPathway` are over-representation tests:
they return significance (p-value) and gene counts, but -- unlike a
differential-expression contrast -- no directional "up/down" statistic.
To still be able to color bubbles the way IPA-style figures do (a
Z-score-like diverging scale), we build a proxy: for every module x cell
type x term, take the **mean kME (module membership)** of the genes
annotated to that term in that cell type, then standardize (z-score)
within each module. Modules/terms with higher-than-average membership
strength score positive (red), lower than average score negative (blue)
-- this reflects how "core" vs "peripheral" the contributing genes are
to the module, not differential expression.

```{r activity-score-proxy}
# gene -> kME lookup, per module (mean kME across cell types the gene appears in)
gene_kme_lookup <- gene_celltype_module %>%
  filter(module != "grey") %>%
  group_by(module, gene) %>%
  summarise(kme = mean(kME, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

add_activity_score <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)

  kme_key <- paste(gene_kme_lookup$module, gene_kme_lookup$gene)
  kme_val <- gene_kme_lookup$kme

  df$mean_kme <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    genes <- strsplit(df$geneID[i], "/")[[1]]
    vals  <- kme_val[match(paste(df$module[i], genes), kme_key)]
    mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, numeric(1))

  df <- df %>%
    group_by(module) %>%
    mutate(activity_score = as.numeric(scale(mean_kme))) %>%
    ungroup()

  df$activity_score[is.nan(df$activity_score) | is.na(df$activity_score)] <- 0
  df
}

enrichment_by_module_celltype <- add_activity_score(enrichment_by_module_celltype)
go_by_module_celltype         <- enrichment_by_module_celltype %>% filter(database == "GO_BP")
```

## Module trajectory shape (nested models)

Instead of a single Pearson correlation, each module's eigengene
trajectory across age is classified with **nested model comparison**:
null (`~1`) vs linear (`~age`) vs quadratic (`~age + age^2`), compared
pairwise with `anova()` (nested F-test). The quadratic term is kept only
if it explains significantly more variance than the linear model alone.
The winning model's fitted values are then passed to an edge-aware
classifier that looks at *where* along the age axis the min/max of the
curve falls, producing an honest label: Increasing, Decreasing,
U-shaped, or Inverted U-shaped (not just "significant/not significant").

Cached to `module_trajectory_shape.csv`: if that file exists it's read
instead of refit -- delete it (or set
`force_recompute_trajectory <- TRUE`) after any upstream change to
`datExpr`/module composition.

```{r module-trajectory-nested-models}
trajectory_cache <- "module_trajectory_shape.csv"
force_recompute_trajectory <- FALSE

df_traj <- data.frame(MEs, age_num = age_num, sample_id = rownames(MEs))
# module_names already defined in the module-eigengenes chunk above


classify_curve <- function(age_num, fit, edge_frac = 0.15) {
  ord   <- order(age_num)
  fit_s <- fit[ord]
  n     <- length(fit_s)

  idx_min <- which.min(fit_s); idx_max <- which.max(fit_s)
  pos_min <- (idx_min - 1) / (n - 1); pos_max <- (idx_max - 1) / (n - 1)

  net_change  <- fit_s[n] - fit_s[1]
  total_range <- max(fit_s) - min(fit_s)

  is_min_edge <- pos_min <= edge_frac || pos_min >= (1 - edge_frac)
  is_max_edge <- pos_max <= edge_frac || pos_max >= (1 - edge_frac)

  category <- if (is_min_edge && is_max_edge) {
    if (net_change >= 0) "Increasing" else "Decreasing"
  } else if (!is_min_edge && is_max_edge) {
    "U-shaped"
  } else if (!is_max_edge && is_min_edge) {
    "Inverted U-shaped"
  } else {
    if (net_change >= 0) "Increasing" else "Decreasing"
  }
  data.frame(net_change = net_change, total_range = total_range, category = category)
}

if (file.exists(trajectory_cache) && !force_recompute_trajectory) {

  module_trajectory <- read.csv(trajectory_cache, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Loaded cached trajectory results from", trajectory_cache, "(",
      nrow(module_trajectory), "modules). Set force_recompute_trajectory <- TRUE to redo.\n")

} else {

  trajectory_results <- list()

  for (mod in module_names) {
    f_null <- as.formula(paste0("`", mod, "` ~ 1"))
    f_lin  <- as.formula(paste0("`", mod, "` ~ age_num"))
    f_quad <- as.formula(paste0("`", mod, "` ~ age_num + I(age_num^2)"))

    m_null <- tryCatch(lm(f_null, data = df_traj), error = function(e) NULL)
    m_lin  <- tryCatch(lm(f_lin,  data = df_traj), error = function(e) NULL)
    m_quad <- tryCatch(lm(f_quad, data = df_traj), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(m_null) || is.null(m_lin) || is.null(m_quad)) next

    p_lin_vs_null <- anova(m_null, m_lin)$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    p_quad_vs_lin <- anova(m_lin, m_quad)$`Pr(>F)`[2]

    if (!is.na(p_quad_vs_lin) && p_quad_vs_lin < 0.05) {
      shape <- "quadratic"; best_model <- m_quad; best_p <- p_quad_vs_lin
    } else {
      shape <- "linear"; best_model <- m_lin; best_p <- p_lin_vs_null
    }

    cls <- classify_curve(df_traj$age_num, fitted(best_model))

    trajectory_results[[mod]] <- data.frame(
      module = sub("^ME", "", mod),
      shape = shape,
      p_value = best_p,
      r_squared = summary(best_model)$r.squared,
      category = cls$category,
      net_change = cls$net_change,
      total_range = cls$total_range,
      n_mice = nrow(df_traj)
    )
  }

  module_trajectory <- bind_rows(trajectory_results) %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(fdr)

  write.csv(module_trajectory, trajectory_cache, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Computed fresh and saved to", trajectory_cache, "\n")
}

cat("Module trajectory shapes (n =", nrow(df_traj), "mice):\n")
print(module_trajectory)

significant_trajectory_modules <- module_trajectory %>% filter(p_value < 0.05) %>% pull(module)
cat("\nModules with a significant age trajectory (p_value<0.05):\n")
print(significant_trajectory_modules)
```

## Combined figure per module: heatmap + composition + trajectory + pathways, all split by cell type

One publication-style figure per module with a significant age
trajectory, echoing the layout of a canonical multi-panel WGCNA/aging
figure, with **every panel split by cell type**:

- **(A) Expression heatmap by cell type** -- z-scored expression of the
  module's top genes (mice ordered by age, left to right), with genes
  grouped into one facet block per cell type of origin -- the
  cell-type-resolved analogue of a standard "genes x samples" module
  heatmap.
- **(B) Composition** -- number of module genes contributed by each cell
  type.
- **(C) Trajectory by cell type** -- one age trajectory per cell type,
  computed from a **cell-type-restricted eigengene**: for each (module,
  cell type) pair, `moduleEigengenes()` is run again on only the subset
  of features belonging to that cell type, so this is not the single
  pooled module eigengene split visually -- it is a genuinely separate
  PC1 computed from that cell type's genes only.
- **(D) Pathway bubble matrix by cell type** -- one bubble grid per
  database (GO Biological Process, KEGG, Reactome), x = cell type, y =
  top pathways for that module, size = % of the module's genes (in that
  cell type) annotated to the term, color = kME-weighted activity-score
  proxy (see `activity-score-proxy` chunk above).
- **(E) Canonical-pathway lollipop** -- -log10(FDR) of each pathway's
  best result across cell types, one panel per database.

```{r module-trajectory-pathway-figure, fig.width=22, fig.height=14, fig.keep='all', results='asis'}

age_num_lookup <- setNames(age_num, rownames(MEs))

# Palette unificada de colores por tipo celular (reutilizada en TODOS los paneles)
celltype_colors <- setNames(
  viridis::viridis(length(target_celltypes), option = "turbo"),
  sort(target_celltypes)
)

# Bases de datos a plotear (excluyendo KEGG)
databases_to_plot <- c("GO_BP", "Reactome")

# --- Helper: safe, significance-ordered GO/pathway term factor -------------
order_go_terms <- function(df, desc_col = "Description", p_col = "p.adjust") {
  term_levels <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[desc_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(.best_p = min(.data[[p_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.best_p)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data[[desc_col]])
  
  df[[desc_col]] <- factor(df[[desc_col]], levels = term_levels)
  df
}

# --- Panel A: expression heatmap, split by cell type ------------------------
plot_module_heatmap_by_celltype <- function(mod, max_genes_per_ct = 15) {
  feats <- gene_celltype_module %>%
    filter(module == mod) %>%
    group_by(celltype) %>%
    arrange(desc(kME)) %>%
    slice_head(n = max_genes_per_ct) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  if (nrow(feats) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  mat <- pseudobulk_hvg[feats$gene_celltype, , drop = FALSE]
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  
  sample_order <- names(sort(age_num_lookup[colnames(z)]))
  
  df <- as.data.frame(z) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_celltype") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene_celltype, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "z") %>%
    left_join(feats %>% dplyr::select(gene_celltype, celltype, gene, kME), by = "gene_celltype") %>%
    mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = sample_order),
           gene_celltype = factor(gene_celltype,
                                  levels = feats %>% arrange(celltype, desc(kME)) %>% pull(gene_celltype)))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = sample_id, y = gene_celltype, fill = z)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "z-score") +
    facet_grid(celltype ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Mice (ordered by age, young -> old)", y = NULL,
         title = "Expression heatmap by cell type") +
    theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 8, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    )
}

# --- Panel B: gene composition per cell type (Corregido: colores consistentes y números) ---
plot_module_celltype_counts <- function(mod) {
  d <- gene_counts_by_module_celltype %>% filter(module == mod)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
```
